text.description_html:
First Impressions CFRBSS Contemporary Appliance / Refrigerator Door Pull

Elegance from this simple modest yet contemporary design makes this appliance pull a very popular choice when dressing up your freezers and refrigerators.

It is packaged with mounting screws for a refrigerator / appliance door panel. Available in Polished or Satin finish.

Specifications for First Impressions CFRBSS Stainless Appliance Pull

  • Pull Diameter: 1"
  • Pull Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Pull Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Pull Handle Material: Stainless Steel Tubing
  • Bracket Diameter at Base: 3/4"
  • Packaged with mounting screws for appliance panel

Available in 4 different standard lengths.

  • FII-CFRBSS-18: Total Length 18" - Center to Center Mount - 12"
  • FII-CFRBSS-24: Total Length 24" - Center to Center Mount - 18"
  • FII-CFRBSS-36: Total Length 36" - Center to Center Mount - 30"
  • FII-CFRBSS-48: Total Length 48" - Center to Center Mount - 42"

    • Note: This appliance handle is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths up to 6 feet. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the appliance handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

    Packaged with mounting screws for a standard 3/4" thick refrigerator/appliance door panel.

    *Sold individually.
